newsitems.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update

newsitems.contents: [p]\[ MISC ][/p][list][*][p]Pet photobook pages now have localized text art.[/p][/*][*][p]Added play menu buttons to manage downloaded Workshop maps.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted VK shader cache extension flags.[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
newsitems.author: Vitaliy
newsitems.contents: [p]\[ MISC ][/p][list][*][p]Agents now wear their equipped gloves during the photobooth photography sessions and in buy menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed grenade crosshair rendering when crosshair thickness is set to 3 pixels[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed formatting of titles in commend and report dialogs[/p][/*][*][p]Improved lighting in the Warehouse map[/p][/*][*][p]Updated workshop convars whitelist with the new crosshair settings[/p][/*][*][p]Stability improvements[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
newsitems.author: Vitaliy
newsitems.contents: [p]\[ MISC ][/p][list][*][p]Various clipping fixes in Rush maps[/p][/*][/list][p]\[ CROSSHAIR ][/p][list][*][p]Fixed visualization of weapon inaccuracy + spread[/p][/*][*][p]Added crosshair outline color option[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new style "Static Quadrant"[/p][/*][*][p]Enabled grenade crosshairs in freeze time for insta-smokes (just hold any grenade attack button)[/p][/*][*][p]Allowed negative gaps for classic dynamic crosshair style[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the classic dynamic crosshair alpha increments to 0.01[/p][/*][*][p]Scope dot scale and color preferences are now included in the new crosshair share code[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the format of the crosshair share code to accommodate newly included crosshair settings[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
newsitems.author: Vitaliy
newsitems.contents: [p]\[ MISC ][/p][list][*][p]Fixed pixel-gaps in various Rush rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]Clipping adjustments in T/CT Castle rooms.[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
newsitems.author: jo
newsitems.contents: [p]\[ RUSH ][/p][list][*][p]Various gap fixes and clipping adjustments.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]\[ GAMEPLAY ][/p][list][*][p]Fixed some cases where loud reloads would persist while trying to stealth reload.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]\[ MISC ][/p][list][*][p]Added sv_clantags_enabled option so custom servers can disable clan tags.[/p][/*][*][p]The eggs of background players in main menu lobbies now rest in nests.[/p][/*][/list]
